page.notes: The first line begins with the fragment "cine" from the word "Medecine" broken over the page edge; kept as a fragment. The printed "toufours" is read as "tousours" (long s) and is doubtful; the printed form may be "tousiours". Before "Achaius" there is a small curved printer's sign (⌣) which I did not transcribe. The "Medecine" and "Eschole" spellings are as printed. Numerous small faint specks and pen-like marks on the scan were ignored.
